title: An envelope from Portland
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: The mailbox. An envelope with a Portland return address. The mother's hand brings it in and sets it on the desk. The strip draws the hand setting it down and nothing else about the hand.

panels.composition: The rural mailbox open. An envelope, thick, the return address as blocks with one legible word: PORTLAND.

image.prompt: close on an open rural mailbox holding a thick envelope with a printed return address, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The MOTHER's hand — ring, cardigan cuff — carrying it up the hall.

image.prompt: close on a woman's hand with a ring and a cardigan cuff carrying a thick envelope, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The hand setting it on the desk's corner. WOOD at the desk, not turning. BARNABY.

image.prompt: a woman's hand setting an envelope on the corner of a desk where a young man sits without turning, a small dog beneath, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The envelope on the desk. Unopened. The pen in Wood's hand, still moving on the strip. The envelope in the corner of every panel after this.

image.prompt: close on a thick unopened envelope on a desk corner beside a young man's hand drawing, black and white, no words

art.line: brush-pen, committed; black and white; xerox

notes: 'Arthur.' The second envelope. Unopened for a week.
